en.headline: Customs seizes 600 million illicit cigarettes in first nine months
en.dek: Commissioner Chan Tsz-tat said the haul nearly matched the 2025 annual total, with 200 million sticks intercepted en route to other destinations.
body: Hong Kong Customs seized 600 million illicit cigarette sticks in the first nine months of 2026, Commissioner of Customs and Excise Chan Tsz-tat said on Saturday.

Speaking on a radio programme, Chan said the volume nearly matched the total seized for the whole of 2025. Of the 600 million sticks, 200 million were destined for other locations but were intercepted in Hong Kong after intelligence was received.

He added that the department plans to introduce more advanced contraband detection equipment at additional border checkpoints to ease manpower pressure while maintaining enforcement against illicit tobacco.
Customs has continued multi-pronged operations targeting storage, distribution and retail of duty-not-paid cigarettes throughout the year.

zh.headline: 海關首九個月檢獲六億支私煙 接近去年全年總量
zh.dek: 海關關長陳子達表示，其中2億支原擬運往其他地方，因接獲情報在港截獲。
body: 香港海關關長陳子達周六表示，今年首九個月共檢獲6億支懷疑私煙，數量接近2025年全年檢獲總量。
陳子達在電台節目指出，當中2億支原擬運往其他地方，但海關接獲情報後在香港截獲。
他表示，部門計劃在更多口岸引入更先進的違禁品偵測設備，以減輕人手壓力，同時繼續打擊私煙活動。
海關今年持續採取多管齊下行動，針對私煙的貯存、分銷及零售環節進行執法。
